prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a distinctly ANIME character design illustration of Cassandra Laurent-Noir (Cass), one adult woman, full body on a plain warm off-white background, portrait 2:3.
Art direction: hand-drawn 2D animation character art, elegant clean ink contours, deliberately simplified facial planes, expressive economical linework, flat local colors with only two or three cel-shaded tones. A little soft painted shading in hair only. Clearly illustrated, leave room for imagination. NO photorealism, NO 3D render, NO realistic skin texture, NO pores, NO detailed individual knit stitches, NO fashion photography. Mature slice-of-life animated drama mood, restrained and thoughtful.
Identity: a petite adult white European woman, compact small-boned silhouette with normal adult anatomy and visibly shorter legs than a fashion model. Softly angular face, modest defined nose bridge indicated by simple drawn lines, expressive dark brown eyes of moderate anime size, thoughtful slightly tired half-lidded gaze, a small hint of stubbornness. Clearly adult, not a child or chibi. Fair warm skin represented by flat color.
Hair: chestnut brown, gently tousled, just past shoulders; subtle asymmetrical silhouette, a SMALL concealed undercut on HER LEFT mostly covered by longer strands, avoid a broad shaved panel.
Clothes: dark charcoal top with subtle asymmetric hem, relaxed black straight trousers, oversized medium warm-gray open cardigan depicted with broad simple folds, plain flat dark ankle boots. Thin round metal glasses and a small plain silver pendant. No earrings or bracelet.
Pose: quiet natural standing, arms loosely at sides with both hands visible, slight three-quarter body and face toward viewer. Slightly guarded posture, no runway stance. Whole head and both feet within frame, generous empty margins.
Palette: chestnut brown, charcoal black, warm gray, ivory background. Subtle warm accent in hair; understated.
No text, labels, watermark, border, props, extra people, inset portraits, fantasy ears, horns, futuristic glowing marks, or decorative background. This is a proposed character visual, not new narrative canon.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art game sprite for Cass in NPC observation room.
Input image is the identity reference: preserve the same adult woman, chestnut shoulder-length tousled hair, subtle asymmetry, thin round glasses, warm gray oversized open cardigan, charcoal top, black trousers, dark ankle boots, tiny silver pendant.
Generate ONE standalone full-body front-facing or very slight three-quarter neutral standing idle sprite. Both arms relaxed slightly away from torso; hands and boots entirely visible. Compact adult proportions adapted to a readable 2D RPG sprite, approximately 3.5 heads tall, not a realistic illustration and not an infant.
TRUE LOW-RES PIXEL ART: design on a logical 32 by 48 pixel grid, displayed at a large exact integer enlargement. Crisp square pixel clusters, hard stepped outlines, limited palette about 16 colors, single-pixel intentional details, flat pixel shading. No anti-aliasing, smooth curves, gradients, painterly texture or blur. The hair silhouette, round glasses, light gray cardigan and dark inner clothes must remain recognizable at 32 by 48 pixels. Simplify pendant to one highlight pixel.
Composition: one sprite centered with even transparent padding, feet level on a common baseline near the bottom, no shadow or floor, no contact sheet or other directions. Entire character fits with clear transparent margins on every side. Genuine transparent background/alpha, no checkerboard baked in, no white background. No text, labels, watermark, border, props, extra limbs, duplicate figures, horns or fantasy ears. Keep a clean readable silhouette.

Create a TINY GAME SPRITE, NOT a large pixel illustration. One Cass character, neutral standing idle facing camera, genuine fully transparent background.
Use the reference ONLY for identity and clothes: chestnut shoulder-length hair, round glasses, warm gray open cardigan, charcoal shirt, black trousers and dark boots. Adult woman.
CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: a classic low-resolution 2D RPG overworld sprite built from ONLY 32 pixels wide by 48 pixels tall, then enlarged with nearest-neighbor into the output canvas. Every logical pixel should be a large visible square. Maximum 16 opaque colors plus transparency. No details smaller than one logical pixel. Thick simple pixel clusters. Head about one third of sprite height, torso one third, legs one third. Compact three-head-tall adult RPG proportions. Broad recognizable hair mass, large round glasses suggested by a few dark pixels, cardigan a simple light gray open shape against dark shirt. Hands are simple pixel mitt shapes. Shoes level on same baseline. Two arms and two legs. NO realistic anatomy or elongated legs, no tiny linework, no individual fingers or fabric texture, no smooth shading, no gradients, no glow, no semi-transparent halo, no floor shadow. Surround with transparent padding. Single character only. NO sheets, no labels or text, no border. The result must remain readable when viewed at 32x48 pixels.

Edit this sprite ONLY to remove the surrounding glow/halo and all background haze. Preserve the character identity, pixel-art shapes, colors, glasses, gray cardigan, dark clothes, body proportions, hands and feet exactly. All pixels outside the hard stepped character silhouette must be fully transparent alpha zero. All interior character pixels must be opaque. Absolutely no drop shadow, glow, bloom, blur, ambient haze, floor or semitransparent fringe. Keep one whole character centered with transparent margins. Do not change pose or add details. This is a game asset cutout for nearest-neighbor display at small size. Genuine clean transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: proposed master character visual of Vera for NPC observation room, matching the supplied Cass illustration's 2D animation drawing style ONLY. The reference is a STYLE reference, NOT Vera's identity; do not copy Cass's brown hair, glasses, face or gray cardigan.
ONE adult woman, full-body neutral standing on plain warm off-white background, portrait 2:3. Hand-drawn refined 2D anime character illustration, clean elegant ink contours, simplified facial planes, expressive economical linework, restrained flat colors and two or three cel-shaded tones, gentle slice-of-life drama atmosphere. No photorealism, 3D, pores, or fabric microtexture.
Vera identity: an adult artificial-origin woman with an elegant slender adult silhouette, softly oval face, gentle attentive lime-green gemstone-like eyes, quiet observant expression with subtle warmth and her own emotional presence. Humanlike synthetic skin, naturally posed, not an emotionless doll.
Hair: rich DEEP PURPLE, nearly black-purple in shadows, understated cool violet highlights like a night sky but NO literal stars or glitter. Straight-to-softly-flowing hair falling a little past shoulders, softly curved face-framing strands, a small simple half-up section secured with a modest dark purple hair clip. No silver hair, no blue eyes, no glasses.
Clothes: contemporary modest white high-collared blouse with restrained tailored cuffs, a flowing deep muted purple long skirt ending above ankles, subtle asymmetrical layered detail in skirt, simple dark flat ankle shoes. Refined clean silhouette with a faint Victorian tailoring influence, no maid uniform, no apron, no servant costume, no corset. No large bow or frills.
Synthetic body details are SUBTLE: a very fine curved seam at each exposed wrist and a small discreet articulated seam on one side of neck visible above collar. Otherwise ordinary humanlike skin. NO exposed mechanical components, glowing circuits, ball joints at elbows/knees, robotic armor or marionette pose. The seams are design details, not wounds.
Pose: relaxed standing, slight three-quarter body facing viewer; hands visible at sides, natural fingers, both feet fully inside frame, generous clear margins. Do not pose as serving or caring for someone. Calm presence with slight individual curiosity, not smiling broadly.
No text, labels, borders, watermarks, props, extra characters, inset portraits, furniture, fantasy ears, horns or unrelated character features. This is a visual proposal, not a new story event.

Edit the supplied Vera character illustration. Change ONLY pose, posture and facial expression; preserve her identity, deep purple long half-up hair with simple clip, lime green eyes, facial structure, white high-collared blouse, dark purple asymmetrical long skirt, dark ankle shoes, subtle synthetic wrist and neck seams, clean anime linework, cel shading, palette and plain warm off-white background.
Make Vera feel quiet, reserved, inwardly attentive and emotionally present, without a deliberate model pose.
Posture: stand naturally upright with weight evenly balanced, torso and shoulders almost front-facing, head level with NO sideways head tilt, no hip sway or S-curve. Shoulders gently relaxed. Feet comfortably close and parallel, not crossed.
Hands: loosely rest together low in front of her abdomen, one hand lightly resting over the other, relaxed natural fingers, no gripping or clasping in distress. Both hands visible. Preserve fine discreet synthetic seams around wrists.
Expression: mouth gently CLOSED in a neutral soft line; no parted lips, pout, alluring smile or flirtatious look. Eyes calm and thoughtful, gaze directed a little to the side of the viewer rather than directly seeking the camera. Eyelids natural, not seductive or exaggeratedly downcast. Subtle warmth and watchfulness, no blush. Not sad, frightened, submissive, vacant or emotionless.
Keep her an adult woman. Full body including shoes, generous margins. Same 2D illustrated animation style, no photorealism. Do not redesign clothes or add accessories. No text, no props, no extra figures.

Edit this Vera character illustration to try a DISTINCTLY DIFFERENT FACE DESIGN. Preserve the deep purple hair color, lime green eyes, subtle wrist/neck synthetic seams, white blouse, purple skirt, quiet upright pose with hands lightly resting together, full-body composition, plain ivory background, clean 2D animation illustration style.
PRIMARY CHANGE: her face is currently too long and narrow. Redesign it as a SHORTER, SOFTER OVAL face with a slightly broader cheek area, a shorter midface, a small compact nose indicated with minimal lines, a shorter distance from nose to mouth and from mouth to chin, and a softly rounded short chin. Avoid the elongated sharp jaw and pointed chin of the reference. Maintain adult facial proportions, not a baby or chibi.
Make the moderately sized anime eyes slightly rounder and gently downturned at the outer corners, naturally spaced, lime-green irises; softer straighter brows, small closed neutral mouth with a trace of warmth. Her expression is reserved, quietly observant and self-contained, emotionally alive. No seductive gaze, pout, worried frown, bashful blush or vacant doll stare.
Give the face a different visual character: approachable softness and calm attention rather than elongated fashion-model elegance. Frame the shorter face with softly curved cheek-length strands; keep the rest of her dark purple half-up long hair and modest clip.
Keep her adult stature and clothes, but do not elongate neck. No photorealism, skin texture, 3D, text, extra accessories or extra figures.

Edit the supplied illustration of Vera. Preserve her CURRENT shorter soft oval face, lime-green eyes, reserved warm expression, deep-purple half-up hair, upright posture with hands gently overlapping in front, white blouse, purple skirt, boots, clean 2D anime illustration style and plain ivory background.
Primary change: make her synthetic articulated DOLL identity noticeably clearer while retaining her emotional humanity and elegant understated appearance.
At both exposed wrists, replace the faint bracelet-like lines with clearly drawn compact ball-jointed-doll wrist articulation: small rounded wrist joint forms, a clean curved separation line, and narrow cool gray shadow in the joint gap. These must read as body construction, NOT jewelry or bracelets. Keep natural normal hands and proportions.
On the exposed side of neck above the high collar, show a distinct but delicate curved synthetic-shell panel boundary extending from just beneath the ear toward the collar, with a small visible neck articulation seam. Do not add a throat cut or wound. These are engineered ceramic-like synthetic skin segments.
On visible fingers, add a few delicate precise articulation seams at knuckles, consistent with high-quality articulated doll hands, without turning hands into metal robot claws. Two normal hands, five fingers each.
Surface: subtly smoother porcelain-like synthetic skin in the same natural warm ivory tone, with restrained clean highlights. Eyes slightly glasslike with crisp green irises and small controlled catchlights, NOT glowing.
Keep facial features and facial softness unchanged. She remains an adult artificial-origin person with her own feelings, quiet and observant. No vacant stare, gothic makeup, cracks, scars, blood, exposed machinery, cables, screws, metal armor, glowing circuits, marionette strings or extra joints across face. No outfit change, no new accessories, text or extra figures. Doll features should be readable on the neck and hands at normal portrait viewing size.

Edit the supplied Vera illustration. The user wants her physical construction to look distinctly like a high-quality BALL-JOINTED DOLL (BJD), not merely a human wearing silver bracelets.
Keep her soft short oval adult face, lime-green eyes, quiet reserved expression, deep-purple half-up long hair, white blouse, deep-purple long skirt, upright pose with hands gently resting together in front, full-body framing, ivory background and clean 2D anime illustration style.
CRITICAL CHANGES:
1. BOTH WRISTS: remove bracelet-like metallic bands completely. Show actual ivory porcelain-colored SPHERICAL WRIST JOINTS. The narrow forearm shell ends in a curved open socket, a small rounded ball visibly bridges into the hand, with a clearly defined dark crescent-shaped recess separating ball and socket. Anatomy is elegantly stylized BJD engineering, not a jewelry ring. Expose enough wrist between cuff and hand for the spherical joint silhouette to be readable.
2. NECK: slightly lower the blouse collar just enough to reveal the base of neck construction. Show an ivory rounded neck ball seated in a shallow torso socket, with a visible curved separation gap and smooth porcelain shell surfaces. Keep this refined and clean. The neck seam is physical doll construction, not a scar, tattoo or metal collar.
3. HANDS: articulated porcelain doll hands with small rounded knuckle segments and fine dark joint gaps; five fingers each, natural delicate relaxed arrangement. Do not cover them with rings.
4. SKIN: warm ivory porcelain-like synthetic material with subtly smooth highlights, color consistent across face, neck and hands; no cracking, no visible metal, no wires. Face remains emotionally alive and gentle. Green eyes can have a controlled glass-like catchlight, not glow.
Keep hidden elbow and knee joints beneath the clothes; do not make clothing transparent or change skirt length. No strings, exposed gears, cybernetic armor, silver bracelets, extra accessories, wounds, blood, text, inset diagrams or additional figures. Keep the same recognizable Vera; only strengthen her BJD body construction.

Edit ONLY the neck and collar area of the supplied Vera illustration.
The exposed spherical neck joint is too large and conspicuous. Replace it with a natural slender adult neck silhouette in the same warm ivory synthetic skin tone, with the main neck-base ball joint HIDDEN INSIDE the blouse collar. Restore the modest white standing collar from her original blouse so it covers the base of the neck. Leave only a small, delicate curved doll-shell seam on ONE SIDE of the neck just above the collar near the ear. No exposed throat sphere, no neck bulge, no dark ring across the front of the throat, no choker. The neck should read as elegant and mostly humanlike at first glance.
Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE: exact soft short oval face, lime green eyes, quiet inward expression, purple half-up hair and clip, pose, white blouse below collar, purple skirt, hands, clearly articulated ivory ball-jointed WRISTS and doll finger joints, shoes, composition, plain ivory background and clean 2D anime illustration style. In particular do not weaken or remove the wrist and finger ball-jointed doll details. No text or added accessories.
